name: Garen

ability.name: Judgment
ability.description: Spins for 3 seconds, dealing physical damage per second to adjacent enemies and reducing incoming damage while spinning.

positioningNotes: Front-center hex to soak the first engage.

name: Vayne

ability.name: Silver Bolts
ability.description: Every third attack deals bonus true damage based on the target's maximum health.

positioningNotes: Back corner, opposite side of enemy assassins.

name: Ziggs

ability.name: Mini Bomb
ability.description: Hurls a bomb at the current target, dealing magic damage to it and half damage to adjacent enemies.

positioningNotes: Back row, central hex for maximum splash coverage.

name: Poppy

ability.name: Buckler Toss
ability.description: Throws her buckler at the farthest enemy, dealing magic damage. The buckler returns and grants Poppy a shield.

positioningNotes: Front line, one hex off center to split cleave damage.

name: Yasuo

ability.name: Steel Tempest
ability.description: Dashes to a new target and slashes in a line, dealing physical damage. Every third cast knocks up enemies hit.

positioningNotes: Second row flank so he dashes after the front line collides.

name: Lux

ability.name: Final Spark
ability.description: Fires a beam across the board in a line, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit.

positioningNotes: Back row, aligned with the enemy carry's column.

name: Tristana

ability.name: Explosive Charge
ability.description: Places a bomb on the current target that detonates after 3 attacks, dealing physical damage in a small area.

positioningNotes: Back corner behind the tank wall.

name: Katarina

ability.name: Death Lotus
ability.description: Channels, throwing daggers at the closest enemies, dealing magic damage and reducing healing.

positioningNotes: Second row center so her lotus clips both flanks.

name: Nautilus

ability.name: Depth Charge
ability.description: Sends a shockwave to the farthest enemy, knocking up and stunning everything in its path.

positioningNotes: Front center; his stun path crosses the most enemies from there.

name: Jinx

ability.name: Get Excited!
ability.description: Gains attack speed on takedown. At maximum stacks she swaps to her rocket launcher, dealing splash physical damage.

positioningNotes: Back corner; reposition away from the enemy's dive threats each stage.

name: Ahri

ability.name: Orb of Deception
ability.description: Fires an orb through the target that returns to her, dealing magic damage both ways.

positioningNotes: Back row center to line the orb through stacked enemies.

name: Leona

ability.name: Solar Flare
ability.description: Calls down a flare on the largest enemy cluster, stunning and dealing magic damage. Leona gains massive damage reduction.

positioningNotes: Front center, main tank hex — she should always take the first cast.

name: Aphelios

ability.name: Moonlight Vigil
ability.description: Fires a volley at the farthest enemies, dealing physical damage and marking them to take bonus damage from his attacks.

positioningNotes: Deep back corner to maximize Sniper range bonus.

name: Kayle

ability.name: Divine Ascent
ability.description: Ascends, gaining attack range and waves of bonus true damage on her attacks. At 3 stars she ascends fully at combat start.

positioningNotes: Back line flank; she scales, so protect her early in the fight.

name: Sett

ability.name: The Show Stopper
ability.description: Grabs the highest-health enemy and slams them into the ground, dealing physical damage in a large area based on their max health.

positioningNotes: Front line, offset from the main tank so both soak separate threats.
